text: I want to resume a problem I have already explored without recapping every meeting and chat first.
One possible demo is a standalone reflection app where a user opens a previous thread and asks what remains unresolved.
A separate reflection app would miss the workplace moment. I want to continue in the tool where I am already working, such as a fresh ChatGPT chat, coding agent, or email draft.
Illustrative meeting excerpt: would the user trust context inserted into a third-party app if they could inspect which earlier moments supported it?
The magic moment is a short dictated request in a fresh third-party agent. Handy should expand it with a compact, source-grounded context packet before paste.
For the first demo, all uploaded conversation turns belong to one thread. The spoken request names the problem; topic classification is unnecessary.
How much context is enough to restore my train of thought without flooding the destination app?
